gen-tourney-gf-arimo: Athletic and loud, Tourney stretches its wide-tracked, bulky little letters out like a jersey number. Arimo comes in underneath with a tall mean line and open rounded glyphs, a sans that lets the heading keep the spotlight.
gen-tourney-gf-armata: Armata reads as a spacious sans, its lowercase filling most of the letter height and each character given room to move. Tourney's wire-thin, uniform strokes make the contrast sharp.
gen-tourney-gf-athiti: Tourney stamps out wide-tracked words with bulky small letters, every stroke cut to one width. Athiti, a plain sans, is easy to size up if needed.
gen-tourney-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible has clipped-looking capitals and ascenders beside its lowercase, with wide-set terminals on every s. And Tourney's crossbars match its stems in thickness, giving the pair a brisk, sporty snap.
gen-tourney-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mon: Approachable, this mono letterform spaces itself far open. Tourney's rounded strokes, like cut lengths of cord, sit above it while the sans-serif text breathes into the white space below.
gen-tourney-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-nex: Tourney bends its wide-tracked letters like wire signage, constant in thickness, with bulky small letters stretching across the line. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, a plain sans, offers unsealed rounds and big lowercase eyes.
gen-tourney-gf-biryani: Approachable Biryani keeps every e eye large and its counters unclogged. Make Tourney small and its wide tracking loses punch, while Biryani at a large size drifts toward the heading's turf.
gen-tourney-gf-blinker: Blinker reads as a sans-serif with open apertures and lowercase filling most of the height, lines holding their thickness throughout. Tourney's stretched, bulky letters give it a loud, athletic partner.
gen-tourney-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic keeps a high-set x-height and a generous c opening. Over a long passage, the plain sans feels modern and professional, with Tourney's unshaded lines standing out above it.
gen-tourney-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads with an open end to every curve, capitals barely taller than lowercase. Tourney's horizontals match its verticals, so both fonts keep a consistent, modern look.
